Running command: kill $(cat /tmp/gridforge.pid) 2>/dev/null; rm -f /app/gridforge.sqlite*; cd /app; npm start >/tmp/gridforge-final.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/gridforge.pid; sleep .8; node - <<'NODE'
const assert=require('assert');(async()=>{let root='http://127.0.0.1:3000',get=()=>fetch(root+'/api/workbooks/ops-plan').then(r=>r.json()),save=x=>fetch(root+'/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(x)});let a=await get(),b=structuredClone(a);assert.equal(a.revision,1);a.workbook.sheets[0].cells.F2='one';assert.equal((await save({baseRevision:1,workbook:a.workbook,userId:'riley'})).status,200);b.workbook.sheets[0].cells.G2='two';let r=await save({baseRevision:1,workbook:b.workbook,userId:'morgan'});assert.equal(r.status,200);let c=await get(),d=structuredClone(c);c.workbook.sheets[0].cells.H2='x';d.workbook.sheets[0].cells.H2='y';assert.equal((await save({baseRevision:c.revision,workbook:c.workbook,userId:'priya'})).status,200);assert.equal((await save({baseRevision:d.revision,workbook:d.workbook,userId:'morgan'})).status,409);console.log('final smoke passed')})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
